We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to join the Growth Intelligence team and lead the development and delivery of high-impact growth projects across SEO, ASO, Learn, Copy, and Translation.

This role will act as the central Product Manager across these functions, transforming business requirements into clear product solutions, aligning stakeholders, working directly with engineers, and ensuring projects are delivered with measurable business impact.
Fluency in both Mandarin and English is a mandatory requirement.
q: Professional fluency in both Mandarin and English is mandatory.
Proven experience as a Product Manager within a Growth Product, Growth Technology, Growth Platform, or Growth Intelligence team.
Strong experience developing, reviewing, and managing MRDs and PRDs.
Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into scalable product and technical solutions.
Experience working directly with engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
Strong business analysis, data interpretation, prioritization, and project management capabilities.
Experience defining product success metrics and measuring post-launch performance.
Ability to manage multiple cross-functional projects simultaneously.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across business and technical teams.
Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, highly cross-functional environment.

SEO platforms, content discovery, technical SEO, or search performance.
ASO, mobile acquisition, app-store conversion, or app growth.
Learning platforms, educational content, or content-led user acquisition.
Copywriting operations, content management systems, or AI-assisted content production.

Growth analytics, attribution, experimentation, automation, or intelligence platforms.
AI-enabled operational workflows and productivity tools.

d: MISAC, Midea Shaker Company is collaboration between Midea Residential Air Conditioners (Midea RAC) and Midea Building Technologies (Midea MBT) with Hussein & Al-Hassan G. Shaker Bros. for Modern Trading Co. LTD (HH-Shaker) aims to establish a joint venture encompassing local manufacturing and sales, dedicated to breaking into the HVAC engineering market.

As the political and economic hub of the Middle East, Saudi Arabia has witnessed rapid development in its infrastructure and engineering sectors under the Vision 2030. MISAC is actively responding to the initiatives of investing in Saudi and local manufacturing, as well as the sustainable development strategy. Leveraging advanced energy-saving technologies and intelligent products, MISAC provides efficient, low-carbon HVAC solutions for the local market, which are widely applied across various fields including residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural, and large-scale public facilities.

This position is to coordinate warehousing and logistics operations across procurement, sales, and production teams, sourcing and managing suppliers for goods receiving, outbound, and in-warehouse activities, and developing SOPs to standardize warehouse operations. The role also oversees transportation and delivery coordination, tracking shipment progress and resolving issues such as delays, damage, or loss to ensure timely and accurate delivery of goods. Successful candidates will offer a strong sense of responsibility, good communication and coordination skills, and the ability to work well under a demanding pace, by partnering closely with the Sales, Production, and Procurement teams as well as external warehousing and transportation suppliers.
q: College degree or above (preferably Bachelor's) in Logistics Management, Supply Chain Management, Warehouse Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
2-5 years of relevant warehouse and logistics management experience; e-commerce or manufacturing warehousing experience preferred.
Solid grounding in warehouse and logistics fundamentals, including storage, sorting, packaging, transportation, and customs clearance.
Proficient in WMS/ERP systems and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Strong analytical skills in logistics cost accounting and inventory analysis, with the ability to identify issues and propose improvements.
Strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail, good communication skills, and the ability to work well under a demanding pace as part of a team.

r: Liaise with procurement, sales, production and customer teams to synchronize logistics and warehousing needs, and source suitable suppliers to ensure smooth goods inbound and outbound.
Manage warehousing suppliers and operations, including receiving, outbound, and in-warehouse processes, from sourcing through execution.
Formulate and improve warehousing and logistics SOPs, and supervise suppliers to standardize their work.
Ensure product quality and consistency between physical inventory and system records, and analyze indicators like inventory turnover and logistics efficiency to drive optimization.
Coordinate transportation with courier and logistics providers, track delivery progress, and resolve abnormalities such as delays, damage, or loss.
Coordinate order dispatch and picking with sales and factory/warehouse teams, and arrange delivery with transporters and customers.
Maintain delivery records and inventory checks, process transporter invoices, and manage the transporter base for long-term reliability.
